k:HH.UI.Card.SubJoined: Nothing changes until you build something for guests. Pick how you want to host.
k:HH.UI.Card.UseForAll: Use these choices for all future games
k:HH.UI.Card.UseForAllTip: Copies modules, difficulty and tutorial level into the template that new games start from.
k:HH.UI.Preset.JustWork.Desc: Standard difficulty, everything on. Start building, we explain on the way.
k:HH.UI.Preset.CozyInn.Desc: Gentler, with fewer ways to lose: no casino and no underworld.
k:HH.UI.Preset.Tycoon.Desc: Everything on with a short guide. Staff, bookings and the ledger are yours to run.
k:HH.UI.Preset.Nerd.Desc: Every slider, formulas and nerd settings. No guide.
k:HH.UI.Tutorial.FullFirstTime.Tip: Full guide in the first colony with this mod, short afterwards.
k:HH.UI.Tutorial.AlwaysFull.Tip: Topics open on first contact, every time.
k:HH.UI.Storyteller.Head: HOSTING DIFFICULTY · {0} %
k:HH.UI.Storyteller.Tip: How hard hosting guests gets in this colony. It is separate from the raid difficulty above.
k:HH.UI.Overview.IncomeTip: Silver paid into your tills since dawn.
k:HH.UI.Overview.VenuesTip: Rooms with a venue sign on the current map.
k:HH.UI.Overview.BankTip: Balance of the colony account at Silverline.
k:HH.UI.Overview.NoIncome: No income yet. It shows up here as soon as a guest pays.
k:HH.UI.Guests.Head: Guests · {0} here · {1} day guests
k:HH.UI.Guests.VanillaNote: The Inn module is off, so ordinary visitors are shown.
k:HH.UI.Guests.SatTip: How happy this guest is, from -1 to +1. Latest reasons:
k:HH.UI.Guests.Col.Name: Guest
k:HH.UI.Guests.HandlingTip: Click to switch: Basics → Accompany → Recruit. Accompany and Recruit need colonists with Hosting work.
k:HH.UI.Venue.ClosedTip: Outside its opening hours. Change the hours on the venue sign.
k:HH.UI.Venue.NoStaffTip: Open, but nobody is on duty. Give a colonist Serving work (or let the venue run without staff on its sign).
k:HH.UI.Venue.NoStockTip: Nothing to sell in the room. Put goods, drinks or meals on a shelf or stockpile inside it.
k:HH.UI.GuestTab.Label: Guest
k:HH.UI.GuestTab.NoInfo: No guest record for this pawn.
k:HH.UI.GuestTab.SatisfactionTip: From -1 (furious) to +1 (delighted). It drives renown, goodwill and whether the guest comes back.
k:HH.UI.Handling.Basics.Tip: Paid services only, no entertainment. Costs no colonist time.
k:HH.UI.Handling.Accompany.Tip: Colonists on Hosting entertain this guest and show them around: mood +1 to +4 by social skill. Costs colonist time. Without a colonist on Hosting it stays Basics.
k:HH.UI.Handling.Recruit.Tip: Like Accompany, plus recruitment talks. A clumsy talk can offend: mood -6, 30 % less spending, leaves half a day early.
k:HH.UI.Guide.Title: Hearth & Harbor Guide
k:HH.UI.Guide.TitleTip: Right-click to hide. You can bring it back in the Hearth & Harbor tab or the settings.
k:HH.UI.Guide.Hidden: Guide hidden. Bring it back with the Guide button in the Hearth & Harbor tab or in the settings.
k:HH.Setting.core.consequenceStage.Desc: How far bad outcomes can climb: 1 mood, 2 renown, 3 goodwill, 4 money, 5 licence, 6 raids, 7 bounty. Follows the hosting difficulty.
k:HH.Setting.core.researchCost.Desc: Multiplies the cost of Hearth & Harbor and Silverline research projects. Follows the hosting difficulty.
k:HH.Setting.core.upkeep.Desc: Multiplies the running costs of your venues and rooms. Follows the hosting difficulty.
k:HH.Setting.core.neverDie.Desc: Guests are knocked down instead of killed and are rescued for free.
k:HH.Setting.core.noHostile.Desc: Guests never turn hostile, whatever their faction thinks of you.
k:HH.Setting.core.infiniteMoney.Desc: Guests always have enough to pay. The guest money factor has no effect while this is on.
k:HH.Setting.core.picky.Desc: Guests expect a little more from every stay (expectation +0.1).
k:HH.Setting.core.feuding.Desc: Hostile factions dislike each other twice as much when they share a roof.
k:HH.Setting.core.mandatory.Desc: Contracts and billeting are forced on you, even below the Overbooked tier.
k:HH.Setting.core.strictInspectors.Desc: Inspectors check three times as often.
k:HH.Setting.core.realConsequences.Desc: Raises the consequence ladder by one stage.
k:HH.Setting.core.ironBank.Desc: No bailout, no overdraft, compound interest without mercy.
k:HH.Setting.core.noResearchGating.Desc: Everything on the Hearth & Harbor and Silverline trees is available from the start.
k:HH.Setting.core.showMath.Desc: Shows nerd settings and formulas everywhere.
k:HH.Setting.core.perfMode.Desc: Fewer guests at once and simpler guest behaviour on slow computers.
k:HH.Setting.core.houseStyle.Desc: The look of furniture and signs. Automatic follows your ideology style, otherwise your highest researched era. Looks only: guests and prices are not affected.
k:HH.Setting.core.keepBuiltStyle: Built furniture keeps its old style
k:HH.Setting.core.keepBuiltStyle.Desc: When the house style changes with a new era, already built furniture keeps its look.
d:Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_OpeningD: Three steps from a bed to your first silver. No research, no zones, no settings.
d:Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_YourGues: Where to see how your guests are doing.
d:Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_FirstVen: A sign turns a room into a business.
d:Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_Bank.des: Silverline keeps your takings safe and lets guests pay by card.
d:MainButtonDef/HH_MainTab.label: hearth & harbor
d:MainButtonDef/HH_MainTab.description: Guests, venues, income and everything else about running a house for visitors.
